title: Riyadh Launches Comprehensive Access Program for People with Disabilities
summary: In Riyadh, a new program dedicated to comprehensive accessibility for individuals with disabilities has been launched to improve their daily lives and societal participation.
body:
In Riyadh, a new program dedicated to comprehensive accessibility for individuals with disabilities has been launched to improve their daily lives and societal participation.

title: Program Launched to Improve Accessibility of Government and Private Buildings for Persons with Disabilities
summary: A new initiative has been launched to enhance the physical accessibility of both government and private buildings for individuals with disabilities, aiming to remove barriers and improve mobility.
body:
A new initiative has been launched to enhance the physical accessibility of both government and private buildings for individuals with disabilities, aiming to remove barriers and improve mobility.

title: Royal Commission for Riyadh City Launches Universal Access Program for People with Disabilities
summary: The Royal Commission for Riyadh City announced the launch of a program aimed at ensuring universal access and accommodation for people with disabilities within the city infrastructure.
body:
The Royal Commission for Riyadh City announced the launch of a program aimed at ensuring universal access and accommodation for people with disabilities within the city infrastructure.
